description: This file defines a Java interface 'MappingStrategies' that specifies strategies for mapping adaptables to signals in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes a method to find a JsonifiableMapper based on a type string.

classes.name: MappingStrategies
classes.description: An interface for strategies that map from Adaptables to Signals, parameterized by a type T extending Jsonifiable.WithPredicate<JsonObject, JsonField>.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds and returns a JsonifiableMapper for a given type, or null if none is found.
